_note: M2N2 paper (Kim, Park, Choo; AAAI 2024), SMD, values from the main paper. Table 1: 'mlp' = MLP column, 'm2n2' = MLP + Ours. Table 3 (ablation, M-2-1 only): the m2n2__normalization-...__adapt-... arms of smd_ablation. Metric mapping, from the official code (utils/metrics.py, Exp/Tester.py): paper F1 = plain point-wise F1 at the run's threshold -> 'f1'; F1-PA -> 'f1_pa'; AUROC -> 'auroc'; AUPRC = auc(recall, precision) by the trapezoid rule -> 'pr_auc'. The paper's MLP F1 uses the best threshold chosen on the test labels (thresholding=off_f1_best), so it is compared with our 'f1_best'. Ablation rows list only threshold-free metrics, because the official scripts use a different threshold per row.
